segments.text: Showing yourself compassion is difficult during love's toughest moments, but that's exactly
when you need it the most.
I love Dr. Kristen F's work on self-compassion.
She suggests three core steps to self-compassion.
First is to recognise your suffering, to acknowledge it.
Second is to move towards that suffering with a level of kindness and empathy.
And third is to acknowledge your suffering in the context of human suffering, that human
beings often suffer and experience these moments of doubt and shame.
I remind myself of these, and it's so helpful for you to do the same.
